```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
if (!exists("SRS.PGA.units", inherits = FALSE)) SRS.PGA.units <- "g"
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "summary", "srs.R"))
SRS_SITE_TEXT <- .reportLabel()
if (!nzchar(SRS_SITE_TEXT) && !is.null(params$site) && length(params$site)) {
  SRS_SITE_TEXT <- trimws(as.character(params$site[[1L]]))
}
```

* For dynamic analyses at `r SRS_SITE_TEXT`, a suite of `r .fmti(SRS$records)` strong-motion records from `r .fmti(SRS$events)` earthquakes and `r .fmti(SRS$providers)` data providers was selected and spectrally matched to the AEP `r .formatAEP(SRS.config$TR)` UHS target for $V_{S30}$ = `r .fmti(SRS.config$Vs30)` m/s. The final matched H1 component of the selected suite spans $M_w$ `r SRS$Mw`, $R_\mathrm{epi}$ `r SRS$Repi`, and PGA `r SRS$PGA`, with record-scale coefficients $c_i$ from `r SRS_SCALE$range`; the relative RMSE between the mean matched PSA spectrum for the H1 component and the target spectrum was `r SRS_STAGE$RMSE`, and the ratio of mean matched PGA to target PGA was `r SRS_STAGE$pgaRatio`.

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "SRS.target", "SRS.selection.text", "SRS.PGA.units", "SRS.range.word",
  "SRS.performance.target",
  "PathSRS", "SrsG", "SRS", "SRS.target.PGA", "SRS.config",
  "SRS_STAGE", "SRS_SCALE", "SRS_PERFORMANCE", "SRS_SITE_TEXT"
), ls()))
```
